why: "уключинное весло" is a coinage no Russian speaker uses; the disambiguator that separates oar from the paddle entry is kept, but phrased idiomatically

gloss is "a ship OR truck built to carry liquid in bulk" and one example is the truck sense ("Tankers deliver fuel to the station twice a week"); Russian танкер is a ship only, so the road-tanker sense was unrepresented
воланчик reads first as a badminton shuttlecock; the sewing term for a flounce is волан
